title: coverforest: conformal predictions with random forest in python
core_idea: Leverage optimized random forest implementations to provide efficient, distribution-free conformal prediction methods (split conformal, CV+, jackknife+-after-bootstrap and adaptive prediction sets) by accelerating out-of-bag score calculations with parallel computing and Cython, and integrate these methods for both regression and classification within a Python package built on scikit-learn.
tldr: A Python package that implements conformal prediction methods tailored to random forests, using optimized RF implementations and computational accelerations to enable practical uncertainty quantification for regression and classification.
